title: The 'favourite energy' message that's really an anti-cheat report

data.plain_language: Game functions were patched or hooked at runtime
The installed app files do not match the official build
An internal integrity checkpoint was altered (exact meaning undocumented)
A debugger is attached to the game process
The phone has root (Android) or a jailbreak (iOS)
The game is running in an emulator rather than a real phone
The game runs inside a dual-app / virtual-space container
The Frida dynamic-instrumentation toolkit is detected
Never written by the client: the decoy set needed ten types but there are only nine detectors
A guarded in-memory value (missions, trophies, action counters) was changed
Despite the name, filled with a native 'signature hash' string, not your player nickname
